SKILL · MIT

任务探究 · task-inquiry

Clarify consequential uncertainty through real tensions, evidence, reasoning, and useful questions.

Get complete Skill on GitHub ↗

When to use it

Use it when results differ from expectations, explanations conflict, or a meaningful choice changes the next action. Clear, settled work can proceed directly.

“This report differs from the dashboard; find evidence that can explain the discrepancy.”

What is included

Includes the standalone method and bilingual guides, with no scripts, required companion framework, or service integration.

After downloading

Open the GitHub package directory above; clone the repository or use GitHub’s Code → Download ZIP, then extract the complete skills/task-inquiry/ folder. Give that folder to a client supporting Skills and follow its installation or discovery mechanism to load SKILL.md and its resources; unzipping alone is not installation. Without native Skill support, an assistant can read the entrypoint and needed resources as task guidance.

Ask naturally; if the client supports explicit invocation, select task-inquiry。The client’s existing authority, authentication, and tool boundaries remain in force.
